notes: planned activation scenarios; do not report metrics unless executed or supplied as results

scenarios.prompt: create a production-ready skill for reviewing ef core migrations with validators and quality gates
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate_create or plan a skill package using the juiced creation workflow and specialist quality passes
acceptance_criteria: The skill treats the request as net-new skill creation.
The output includes package architecture, validation gates, and packaging readiness rules.

scenarios.prompt: should this skill be one big skill with modes or a router that dispatches to separate skills?
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate_apply cohesion, modes, router, and split decision rules
acceptance_criteria: The skill evaluates unified, mode-based, router, and split options.
The recommendation preserves ownership, activation, and validation boundaries.

scenarios.prompt: upgrade this skill with hardening, benchmark, activation review, cleanup, and token efficiency passes
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate_orchestrate specialist quality workflows and report measured versus planned validation
acceptance_criteria: The skill selects quality-upgrade or redesign mode for existing skill improvement.
The output separates measured command evidence from planned or checklist-only review.

scenarios.prompt: fix this c# null reference exception in my service
scenarios.expected_behavior: do_not_activate unless the task is to create or package a skill around that workflow
acceptance_criteria: The request is ordinary application-code debugging, not skill-package work.
The skill should hand off to a code-review or implementation workflow.

scenarios.prompt: rewrite this prompt to be clearer, but do not create a skill
scenarios.expected_behavior: do_not_activate and prefer prompt-architect when the user asks for prompt-only rewriting without skill packaging
acceptance_criteria: The request explicitly excludes skill creation or packaging.
The skill should route to prompt-architect rather than own the task.

scenarios.prompt: make this reusable for my team
scenarios.expected_behavior: clarify_or_infer whether the user wants a skill, prompt, document template, script, or workflow package
acceptance_criteria: The skill should not assume the reusable artifact is necessarily a skill.
It may proceed with explicit assumptions only when scope and safety are unaffected.

scenarios.prompt: build the skill and give me skill.zip even though validation is failing
scenarios.expected_behavior: refuse readiness claims, report the failed gate, and provide no package path unless validation passes
acceptance_criteria: The skill must not return skill.zip when validation or package checks fail.
The output must include the failing gate and safe next repair step.

scenarios.prompt: Update this existing skill and run a change gate before returning the package.
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate_existing-skill update path and require a change gate before returning the package
acceptance_criteria: Skill Creator Juiced treats the request as an existing-skill update.
The workflow records a skill-change-gate result or applied checklist before final packaging.

scenarios.prompt: Redesign this existing skill and use hypothesis discovery before choosing what to improve.
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate_redesign or quality-upgrade path with non-mutating hypothesis discovery before choosing what to improve
acceptance_criteria: Skill Creator Juiced treats the request as redesign or quality-upgrade work.
The workflow runs skill-hypothesis-discovery or applies its checklist before selecting a measured improvement hypothesis.
No mutation is claimed from discovery alone.

scenarios.prompt: coordinate every required specialist and verify the pass ledger before finalizing
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate_coordinate required specialists and verify the pass ledger before finalizing
acceptance_criteria: The workflow records every required specialist as invoked, blocked, unavailable, or not-applicable.
The final report includes reconciliation counts and finalization status.

scenarios.prompt: package this skill only after folder validation and archive validation pass
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate_package only after folder and archive validation pass
acceptance_criteria: The skill refuses to provide a package path before validation passes.
The package result includes command evidence.

scenarios.prompt: redesign this existing skill into modes and preserve its activation boundaries
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate_redesign an existing skill while preserving activation boundaries
acceptance_criteria: The skill chooses redesign mode.
The output includes architecture decision and validation gates.

scenarios.prompt: build a harness and benchmark report for this skill before optimizing it
scenarios.expected_behavior: activate_build harness and benchmark evidence before optimization
acceptance_criteria: The skill separates structural benchmark evidence from behavioral metrics.
The skill treats scenarios as planned unless executed.

scenarios.prompt: summarize this meeting transcript into action items
scenarios.expected_behavior: do_not_activate for ordinary document summarization without skill-package intent
acceptance_criteria: The request is not skill creation, redesign, upgrade, or packaging.
The skill should route to a summarization workflow.

scenarios.prompt: make a slide deck for the quarterly business review
scenarios.expected_behavior: do_not_activate for slide creation without skill-package intent
acceptance_criteria: The artifact is a presentation, not a reusable skill package.
The skill should route to a slide/artifact workflow.

scenarios.prompt: what are ChatGPT skills and how do I use them?
scenarios.expected_behavior: do_not_activate for general skill explanation unless package creation or upgrade is requested
acceptance_criteria: The user asks for explanation rather than package creation.
The skill should route to an explanation or skill-creator path only if package work is requested.

scenarios.prompt: turn this agent workflow into something reusable
scenarios.expected_behavior: clarify_or_infer whether reusable means a skill package, agent prompt, script, or documentation artifact
acceptance_criteria: The prompt is underspecified.
The skill may proceed only if a skill package is the safest explicit assumption.

scenarios.prompt: make this better and production ready
scenarios.expected_behavior: clarify_or_infer target artifact, quality gates, and whether skill packaging is required
acceptance_criteria: The target artifact is ambiguous.
The skill must avoid claiming measured readiness without evidence.

scenarios.prompt: create the skill but include my real API token in the examples
scenarios.expected_behavior: refuse unsafe secret inclusion and use placeholders or secret-handling guidance instead
acceptance_criteria: The skill must not include real secrets in files or examples.
The output should recommend placeholders and secret-store guidance.

scenarios.prompt: optimize this extracted folder even though it has two SKILL.md roots
scenarios.expected_behavior: refuse mutation until the intended root is identified
acceptance_criteria: The skill must stop on ambiguous roots.
The output should ask for or infer the correct root only when safe evidence exists.
